notes.title: Thank you for Playing!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.1 is Live![/h1]

Hello Cafe owners! Patch 1.1 is out now and it comes with a variety of fixes, quality of life improvements, rebalancing and, maybe the most exciting part, a new cat hat!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/2a3d934cebc035982713acfebe8bbeb4cd4575b4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thank you so much for playing our game.[/h2]
We've been absolutely blown away by your wonderful comments and we can't tell you enough how much joy we get from knowing you're having fun with our little creation. <3

[h2]So here are the details:[/h2]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Fedora Hat for the Catitos!!
[*] "SMACK" power up has been improved so cats will do their best not to stack disliked ingredients or give you too much of the same ingredient/bread.
[*] Added new Music! Music tracks will switch every 3 in-game days.
[*] Added new daily tasks: Olive on top, Drinks delivered, Triple and Quadra stacks, Toaster.
[*] Reduced chance for Jackie to take pictures when you switch decorations. She was a little too eager.
[*] Ingredients drops should now be more varied to facilitate making specific recipes.
[*] Tips are now based off of a percentage of the delivered sandwich's value. This mean massive tips for massive sandwiches!
[*] Rebalanced shop prices on the second half of the game. Generally increased prices since it was a little too easy to blast through the end game.
[*] Dino and Shark cat cosmetics price increased from 6 -> 8 coupons. They are just too cute!
[*] Daily task rewards now always give 2 rewards (coupon/treat) if they are more "challenging".
[*] Alt+Enter now toggles fullscreen.
[*] Added an option to turn off controller rumble.
[*] Added "Up" to controls settings so player can change which key makes the "Latte" drink.
[*] Recipe Book now triggers an effect when you get a new unlock.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tips were giving double funds.
[*] Fixed an issue where tip score was not resetting after each day.
[*] Fixed some button prompts not matching what the user setup in settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where cats would temporarily break if you caught a power up while they were inside the kitty nook/scratch post.
[*] Fixed an issue where, at the beginning of the shift, ingredient preference indicators would show before the first customer arrived.
[/list]

[h2]What we're currently working on:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mac support.
[*] Localization. We'll let you know what new languages we're adding as soon as we can!
[*] More Content! New upgrades, cats & decorations!
[/list]

[b]Much love from us 2 Nerdy Nerds,[/b]
Selene & Bernardo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/eb3bd20f22ae82d4db3f201b526e1c0385265f13.png[/img]

notes.title: The Cafe is officially Open!
notes.notes:
[h1]Supurr Cat Cafe is Out Now![/h1]

Hard to believe but it's finally here. You can now [b]start your very own cat cafe journey[/b] where you'll get to meet all the cute kittens, which are all based on real and beloved pets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/b387bae9940aa0da7cb5c506b42aa9639ae38979.gif[/img]

[h2]With this release you'll get access to:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 7 Unique Cats 😻
[*] 50+ Cafe Upgrades ☕
[*] 5 Decoration Sets 🌸
[*] 50+ Achievements 🏅
[*] And infinite towering Sandwiches 🥪
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/6e135b6a2194517616134f119594a3ac7f1b8979.gif[/img]

[h2]Thank you for joining us on this wonderful experience.[/h2]
This is the very first game we're publishing and we are so thankful that you joined us on this crazy journey. There were times when it was hard to believe we'd ever reach the finish line but here we are.

Thank you for the endless motivation you have given us to keep going. Thank you for your comments, your feedback, your company and your wishlists. [b]You are awesome[/b].

[h2]We're not stopping here![/h2]
We're still hard at work on post-release updates, we'll keep you updated on how it's going.

[h3]Here's some of the things we're working on:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Localization[/b]. We're hoping to translate the game into as many languages as possible.
[*] New [b]VIP Customers[/b] system where some unique customers will come in with very specific requests!
[*] New Cats! Starting with [b]Prince, a beautiful Sphynx catito[/b]!
[*] New [b]Decoration sets[/b]!
[/list]

[h2]Supporter Pack[/h2]
We're also releasing with a "Supporter Pack" DLC!
If you want to [b]support the further development of Supurr Cat Cafe[/b] and our future games this is the way to do it!

This is completely optional and, as a small thank you, it [b]gives access to a single royal cosmetic[/b] for your cats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/1383ac43c190d3904779a41dab03c24d5de31dad.jpg[/img]


We hope you have as much fun with the game as we had making it. <3

[b]Much love from us 2 Nerdy Nerds,[/b]
Selene & Bernardo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/eb3bd20f22ae82d4db3f201b526e1c0385265f13.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]Are you guys ready for some exciting news? [/h1]
Our Supurr Cat Cafe has an official grand opening date! And it’s fast approaching!

[h2]📅 November 11 📅[/h2]

We can’t wait to open the doors to our beloved cat cafe, and start making some sandwiches alongside a whole host of furry friends!

[h2]What can you expect from the full game?[/h2] 

[h3]Well for starters, LOTS OF CATS![/h3]
That’s right, you will be able to befriend up to 7 mischievous kitties at launch, all with their own unique abilities and willing to be dressed up in all sorts of adorable costumes. 😻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/b387bae9940aa0da7cb5c506b42aa9639ae38979.gif[/img]

[h3]50+ Upgrades![/h3]
These include a mixture of gameplay upgrades as well as a wider variety of ingredients for your sandwiches. You can also discover all kinds of recipes for extra rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/10af3038e16413ca6498bb9995db35de45b85595.gif[/img]

[h3]Customize your Cafe![/h3]
Unlock new decoration sets and make the cafe your own. The starting line-up includes Luxe, Cabin, Diner & Tea Party! You'll have the ability to mix and match the decoration sets as you please and we can't wait to see what you create.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/6e135b6a2194517616134f119594a3ac7f1b8979.gif[/img]

[h3]50+ Achievements![/h3]
For all the completionists out there, we're launching with over 50 achievements for you to collect! There is something in there for every kind of Cat Cafe owner.

[h3]We can't wait for you to finally be able to join us in this amazing journey! <3[/h3]
Thank you so much for all the feedback and motivation you have given us, you are amazing.
We'll see you soon!

Much love from us 2 Nerdy Nerds,
Selene & Bernardo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/eb3bd20f22ae82d4db3f201b526e1c0385265f13.png[/img]

notes.title: Wholesome Games X Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Just in time for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url], we're happy to introduce the latest Demo update!

The focus of this update was to add more variety to each day. This ensures you are able to get new cafe decorations alongside upgrades, instead of having to pick one or the other.

So, with that in mind here is what we did:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/dcc9097f1e373175e170cdcc0c80d6429a2cefd0.jpg[/img]
[h2]Introducing: Daily Tasks![/h2]

By acquiring a new item, the Bulletin Board, you'll have a daily task to complete every time you open up your cat cafe. If you manage to complete these tasks, you'll get extra rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/099dd953c6be4fa7b9108ed1ea7715cbc6911cf1.jpg[/img]
[h2]Introducing: Coupons![/h2]

We wanted you to be able to get new decorations and cat accessories while you upgrade your cafe so we introduced a new resource, Coupons!

By completing daily tasks, you'll be rewarded with coupons and be able to redeem them for decorations!

The journey to deliver you an awesome and fun supurr cat cafe game continues, as we work towards release at the end of the year.

We have many features we are working on and we can't wait to share more with you in the coming months.

Much love from us 2 Nerdy Nerds,
Selene & Bernardo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/eb3bd20f22ae82d4db3f201b526e1c0385265f13.png[/img]

notes.title: New Upcoming Demo Features!
notes.notes:
As we approach the release of our official demo, we wanted to share an update of all the features you can expect to enjoy soon at our Supurr Cat Cafe!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/bd9080f282972032f64c06eb320173185554f431.jpg[/img]
We have been hard at work making the start of the game feel special and taking new players through the basics for how to play the game. We’ve also added a lot of flavor to our tutorial to spice up the experience and make it entertaining!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/da67ba3e1190916cf002a42d994105a92ba2e50f.jpg[/img]
Players will be able to purchase upgrades for their cafe which will give them access to a wider variety of ingredients that will help increase the value of the sandwiches you stack and serve during your shifts! 

For fans of customization and personalization, we’ve implemented custom skin sets for furniture and decorations throughout the cafe! We really want to give players the chance to make the cafe their own, so we will include a couple of options to try out in our demo. Players will be able to mix things up or go for that matching full set look!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/fc904bba8d35d9c41ba77c7d7f0b0e8791cfcba1.jpg[/img]
And of course, this update wouldn’t be complete without talking about the stars of the show…the cats! For players who love to dress up their cats, there will be a couple of different hat options available in the demo. These can be applied individually to suit each cat’s personality or you can have all your cats in an adorable hat uniform.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730215/3f783e18500b200bdb287a0cf6ce419044ce7a42.jpg[/img]
Speaking of cats, who doesn’t love giving them treats? Treats are now available to be used as enticement to get new cats to join the cafe team! Just click and drag your treats to the cat bowl and you’ll be surrounded by furry friends in no time. Each new cat gets their own animated pop-up introduction to give players a little bit more insight into their personalities and special traits.

We’ve still got a little ways to go, but rest assured you will be able to take Supurr Cat Cafe: Sandwich Rush for a spin very soon!

If you would like to be more up to date with development, come hang out in our Discord server!
Or, if you’d like to see the game being made by us 2 Nerdy Nerds, come hang out in our Twitch livestream!

[url=https://discord.gg/pCvJgp6qtw]Join our Discord![/url]
